headline: Charter Communications (CHTR) Files Shelf Registration And Launches Major Debt Exchange Offer
summary: Charter Communications filed a new shelf registration for potential future debt offerings. The company launched a fixed-income exchange offer for secured senior notes due in 2038 and 2041. These moves relate to Charter Communications' capital structure and debt profile and matter for bondholders and equity investors in NasdaqGS:CHTR. Charter Communications, traded as NasdaqGS:CHTR, is making sizeable changes to how it finances its business through new debt tools. The stock closed at $144.98...
